description: Fires when column 5 is empty and dropping a stone there would be bad for me because of the cell above, (1,5): the opponent already threatens a win at (1,5), would get new winning cells by playing there, or has 2-3 stones in open lines through (0,5)/(1,5). Off if col 5 has a stone, or (without a (1,5) threat) the opponent threatens (2,5) or any immediate win/must-block exists.
effect: Suppresses column 5: forcing it high on a non-firing position cut col 5 from 0.16 to 0.00 and spread that probability to cols 4, 6, 0 and 2. Zeroing it on firing positions leaves col 5 near 0 (other circuits also suppress it) but moves probability among other columns, e.g. col 3 -0.23 and col 6 +0.34, or col 3 -0.20 and col 1 +0.20.
notes: Every top example has col 5 empty. Activation flips with side to move, so it depends on stone colour. H1 (their win cell at col5 landing+1): F1 0.38. H5 (opponent open windows through empty col-5 cells): 0.50. H7 (simulate me at (0,5), them at (1,5), count new win cells): 0.48. H8 = H5+2*H7: 0.615. H9 = H8 counting windows only through rows 0-1 of col 5, zeroed when (1,5) is not their win and there is a (2,5) opponent threat or any immediate win/must-block: F1 0.695 (P 0.81, R 0.61), AUROC 0.80, sim share 0.51. Adding my own (1,5) threat as a trigger or lowering the threshold hurt (0.61-0.62). Missed: sparse early boards with col 5 empty. Synthesis best 20.26, below dev max 21.67.
